tei:div.tei:p: sa skya panṭi ta'i bstod pa bzhugs/ /

na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes gcig bsdus nas/ /'dzam gling byang phyogs chos kyi bskyangs phyir du/ /lha las babs pa'i gdung brgyud rin po che/ /'jam dbyangs brgyud mar byon la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyad par gnas lnga mkhyen dang mu stegs btul/ /gdug rtsub rgya hor chos la sbyar bas na/ /sa skya paṇa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhes/ /snyan pas sa gsum khyab der bstod par bgyi/ /mgon khyod 'jam pa'i dbyangs su nges bzhin du/ /yid dam zhal gzigs ma 'ongs mkhyen sogs la/ /ngo mtshar ci mchis 'on kyang dman pa'i ngor| |tshul des bstod la'ang bdag cag rjes yid rangs/ /'dir ni mkhas mchog mang pos ma rnyed pa'i/ khyed kyi bka' drin mtshungs med yid bzhin nor// mang zhig rnyed 'di bstod tshig byi dor gyis/ /thub bstan rgyal mtshan rtse la bdag gis 'god/ /byang phyogs 'di na mkhas pa'i nga rgyal can/ /bla ma mchog la'ang brnyas thabs byed pa'i tshe/ /mgon khyed bla ma kun gyi bran mdzad pas// mkhas rnams lam zab bla mas bskyangs pa lags/ /bsam pa bzang na ngur smṛg mi dgos zhes/ /bstan 'dzin phal cher dge bsnyen tshul 'dzin tshe// mgon khyed bstan la rab byung bsnyen rdzogs pas/ /sa steng ngur smṛg 'dzin pas bkang pa lags/ /rnam nges mdor bsdus tsam gyis chog shes nas/ /mdo dang sde bdun ming tsam gyur pa'i tshe/ /khyedakyi lhag bsam rta bdun legs bskyed pas| |phyogs kun rnam 'grel nyi mas khyab pa lags/ /sgra dang snyan ngag sdeb sbyor la sogs pa/ /tha snyad gtsug lag ming tsam med pa'i tshe/ khyed kyis rgya bal mkhas pa kun bsten nas/ /blo gsal mkhas pa'i khri la bkod pa lags// rtog ges khengs pa'i mu stegs ston pa 'gas/ /bod yul ba lang gnas su 'dzin pa'i tshe/ khyed kyi dngos stobs rigs pa'i gad rgyangs sgra/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bar du sgrags pa lags/ /'ga' zhig blun dad tsam zhig gtsor bzung nas/

/chos dang chos min mtshungs par 'jug pa'i tshe/ khyed kyi chos dang 'jig rten lugs gnyis kyi/ /rigs dang mi rigs legs par phye ba lags// mthong tshad bsad na thos tshad 'dar ro zhes/ /shar phyogs rgyal po ngan pa'i lung bud tshe/ /lung bstan dgongs nas 'o rgyal khyad bsad pas/ /bod 'bangs hor gyi 'jigs las skyabs pa lags// rang phyogs spel zhing gzhan phyogs nyam phyir du/ /gnyen bshes mnar nas rang phyogs sgrub pa'i tshe/ /rang rang chos lugs tshul bzhin skyongs shig ces/ /phyogs lhung sdang zhugs ring du spangs pa lags| |mdor na shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i mthar thug pa'i/ /skye rgu mtha' dag chos dang zang zing gis/ /dpal 'byor bla na med pas bskyangs tshul la/ khyod dang cha tsam mtshungs pa'ang ma mchis lags/ /e ma yang dag pa dang ltar snang gis| |skyon yon 'byed pa'i blo ldan gzur gnas dkon/ /legs par shes na snying nas ci mi gus/ khyed kyi yon tan mi brjod shes ldan su/ /rang gi bla mas phyogs 'dzin kun spangs te/ /'dzam gling mtha' dag mtshungs par bskyangs bzhin du/ /bdag cag phyogs lhung gdon gyis gtses rnams la/ /brtse ldan khyed kyi thugs rje ji ltar 'jug /mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis lhag par brgyan pa'i sku| |tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis chos char 'bebs pa'i gsung*/ /ji lta ji rnyed legs par mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /ldan nges khyod la snying nas bdag phyag 'tshal// de ltar shes nas dad pa'i bstod tshig gis/ /shis brjod gser gyi me tog 'di stor bas/ khyed kyi thugs rjes nam mkha' kun gang nas/ /'gro la phan bde'i char chen 'beb rgyur cig /de skad mgon de'i rjes 'jug stag tshang pa/ /pradzña ratnas sbyar ba'i dge ba 'dis/ /mgon po mchog de'i thugs rje'i nyi 'od kyis// thub bstan pad tshal phyogs mthar rgyas gyur cig/ //bkra shis shog// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/sa skya panṭi ta'i bstod pa/
